I'll read the current batch-10 files and check whether `systemd-journald` has an `ExecReload` on Johnny before changing the reload path.`systemd-journald` on Johnny has `ExecStart` and no `ExecReload`. I'll make those reloads non-fatal in the helper, the apply path, and the rollback block, and I'll correct the expect line.## Detail

`systemctl cat systemd-journald` on Johnny shows `ExecStart=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-journald` and no `ExecReload`. A `systemctl reload systemd-journald` under `set -euo pipefail` would fail with “Job type reload is not applicable” and abort the rest of the helper.

The revert helper in `docs/cis-fix/batch-10.sh` now runs:

`systemctl reload systemd-journald || systemctl try-restart systemd-journald || true`

That line is inside the existing “unit is active” check. `rm -f` of the tar and `REVERTED` still run if reload fails. The same pattern is on the apply path after the `61-batch10-forward-syslog.conf` write. `systemd-analyze cat-config` still has to show `ForwardToSyslog=yes` or the script prints `STOP-journal-forward`. PASTE 2 does not reload journald. The standalone syslog rollback in `docs/cis-fix/batch-10.md` reloads rsyslog first, then uses the same non-fatal journald line, so a journald failure cannot hide a missed rsyslog reload if the shell has `set -e`.

The plan now says the first run today ends in `STOP-collector-514` after `GRUB-OK`. That stop is not a rollback trigger. `BATCH10-SSH-DONE` prints only after TCP 514 accepts. The neighbor state in the live read is `REACHABLE`. GRUB 1.4.1 and the 3.2.7 four-module logic are unchanged. `bash -n docs/cis-fix/batch-10.sh` passed. CSV was not touched.

## Relay

Claude: journald on Johnny has no ExecReload (systemctl cat, 2026-11-04). Helper, apply, and md rollback now use `reload || try-restart || true` so set -e cannot skip tar rm / REVERTED or BATCH10-SSH-DONE. Expect line: first run is GRUB-OK then STOP-collector-514, not a rollback. Neigh state text is REACHABLE. 1.4.1 and 3.2.7 untouched. bash -n OK. CSV untouched.

- Checked Johnny: `systemd-journald` has `ExecStart`, no `ExecReload`.
- Helper reload is non-fatal so tar removal and `REVERTED` still run.
- Apply-path journald reload is the same non-fatal line; `cat-config` remains the gate.
- Markdown rollback uses reload rsyslog, then the same journald fallback.
- Expect text: today’s run stops at `STOP-collector-514` after `GRUB-OK`; that is not a rollback.
- Neighbor state text updated to `REACHABLE`.
- GRUB 1.4.1 and 3.2.7 left as approved. Script syntax check passed.
